release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.2 Formwork Block Encapsulation, WinUI 3 Column Toggles & Theme Palettes:
• AutoCAD Formwork Block (STRUCTURAL_FORMWORK_PLAN): Background columns, slabs, drops, openings, beams, and walls are encapsulated in a single AutoCAD block on S-FORMWORK-BLOCK layer so draftsmen can window-select and copy tendons effortlessly.
• WinUI 3 FluentToggleSwitches: Dedicated toggle strip directly above the table with blue pill switches and On/Off text matching Windows 11 Fluent design.
• UI Table Column Display: All columns remain completely visible in the application data table (#all), while toggle switches cleanly govern CAD shop drawing and Excel exports.
• Distinct Window Backdrop Themes: Simplified theme names (Mica, Mica Old, Acrylic, Dark Solid) with instant palette tint updates across all panels.
• Monochrome White Icons: Minimalist, high-contrast vector silhouettes for Live Anchors, Dead Anchors, and Pan Boxes.
• Zero-Flashing Silent Updates: Eliminated download repacking loop and added compatibility asset links to prevent 404s.
